claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a front suspension fork and a rear coil shock absorber.
The witness report states the wheel diameter was not shown.
The witness identifies the item as a mountain bike with knobby tires and suspension.

risks.risk: Drivetrain (gears, chain, derailleur) may be seized or worn out.
risks.proof: A video showing the gears shifting smoothly through all speeds while the pedals are turned.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a full drivetrain replacement.

risks.risk: Braking system may be non-functional or unsafe.
risks.proof: A video demonstrating the brakes stopping the wheels effectively.

risks.risk: Suspension components may be seized or have lost damping properties.
risks.proof: A video showing the front and rear suspension compressing and rebounding under weight.

risks.risk: The frame may have structural cracks or hidden weld repairs.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the frame joints, especially around the head tube and bottom bracket.
risks.if_unproven: as a damaged frame with scrap value only.

risks.risk: Tires and tubes may not hold air or have perished rubber.
risks.proof: A photo of the tires fully inflated or a video of them being pumped.
risks.if_unproven: as needing immediate tire and tube replacement.

proof_requests: Video of the gears shifting through all rear cogs.
Video of the brakes being applied while the bike is in motion or wheels are spinning.
Close-up photo of the tire sidewall to confirm the '26' size claim.
Video of the suspension being tested (pushed down).
Clear photos of the underside of the frame and weld points.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a KONEKT dual-suspension mountain bike, allowing for a baseline valuation at its worst-case functional condition.
